post_title: What will Hon Hai (Foxconn) report as net profit attributable to owners of the parent for Q3 2026 (in NT$ billions)?

question.title: What will Hon Hai (Foxconn) report as net profit attributable to owners of the parent for Q3 2026 (in NT$ billions)?
question.description:
Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. (Foxconn; TWSE: 2317) is the world's largest contract electronics manufacturer and the largest server maker for Nvidia. AI-related cloud and networking products have become its main growth engine: cloud and networking products were 51% of Q2 2026 revenue — the first quarter above half — while smart consumer electronics (including iPhone assembly) were 29%, computing 15% and components/other 5%.

Recent quarterly results (NT$ millions; profit attributable to owners of the parent):
- Q3 2025 (base quarter): revenue 2,058,949; gross margin 6.35%; operating margin 3.43%; non-operating income 16,357; income tax 20,863; net profit 57,673 (+17% YoY, a third-quarter record); net margin 2.80%.
- Q1 2026: revenue 2,119,533; operating margin 3.57%; net profit 49,919; EPS NT$3.56.
- Q2 2026: revenue 2,525,894 (+41% YoY); gross margin 6.12%; operating margin 3.75%; non-operating income only 63 versus 8,553 a year earlier (reflecting foreign-exchange losses); effective tax rate 26.2%; net profit 59,974 (+35% YoY, a second-quarter record); EPS NT$4.27; net margin 2.37%; non-controlling interests took 10,082 of consolidated net profit after tax.
- H1 2026: revenue 4,645,428 (+35%); net profit 109,893; EPS NT$7.84.

Q3 2026 revenue is already known. On 5 October 2026 Hon Hai reported unaudited consolidated third-quarter revenue of NT$3,026.9 billion, up 20.44% QoQ and 47.12% YoY, above the LSEG SmartEstimate of NT$2.83 trillion. September revenue alone was a record NT$1,158.6 billion — the first month above NT$1 trillion — and nine-month revenue was NT$7,669.8 billion (+39.53% YoY). In August the company said it expected Q3, the traditional peak season, to "gradually pick up", and its Q2 deck projected high-double-digit QoQ growth in AI rack shipments in Q3.

Because the profit line is not yet public, the open questions are margin and below-the-line items. Local analyst models published after the revenue release put Q3 2026 EPS at roughly NT$5.10–6.11, i.e. net profit attributable to the parent of roughly NT$72–86 billion (about +25% to +50% YoY), depending on assumed gross margin (6.12%–6.35%), operating margin (about 3.76%–3.8%), foreign-exchange gains or losses, and the minority-interest share (14.4% of consolidated net profit in Q2 2026). Hon Hai does not provide numerical earnings forecasts. A useful read-across: subsidiary Foxconn Industrial Internet (SSE: 601138) reported Q3 2026 revenue of RMB 383.6 billion (+57.7% YoY) and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 16.6 billion (+60.4% YoY). Hon Hai shares had gained about 10% year-to-date as of early October 2026, against a 72% rise in the Taiwan market.

Timing: Hon Hai scheduled its FY26 third-quarter investor conference for 12 November 2026 at 15:00 Taipei time (07:00 UTC) and publishes the quarterly results — press release plus a slide deck containing the income statement — on that day, as it did for Q3 2025 (12 November 2025) and Q2 2026 (12 August 2026).

question.resolution_criteria: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. (TWSE: 2317) is scheduled to publish its FY2026 third-quarter results at its investor conference on 12 November 2026. This question resolves to the figure Hon Hai reports as profit attributable to owners of the parent company for the quarter 1 July – 30 September 2026 — the line labelled "Profit (Loss) Attributable to Owner of the Parent" in the income statement of the Q3 2026 results slide deck (file named Hon_Hai_3Q26_Results_English_*.pdf, linked under the 2026/11/12 entry at https://www.foxconn.com/en-us/investor-relations/investor-relations-activities/investor-conference). That NT$-millions figure takes precedence over any rounded figure given in the corresponding Q3 2026 results press release (linked from https://www.honhai.com/en-us/press-center/press-releases/latest-news). The reported figure is denominated in NT$ millions; the answer is that figure divided by 1,000, i.e. expressed in billions of NT$ — for example, if the reported figure is NT$78,500 million, the answer resolves as 78.5. Consolidated net profit after tax including non-controlling interests does not count.
question.fine_print: The figure as first published is used; any later restatement, review or audit adjustment does not change the resolution. If the two Hon Hai pages above are inaccessible or do not display the figure, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) reporting the company's reported quarterly figure will be used. If the Q3 2026 results are published later than 13 November 2026, the question resolves once they are published.
